mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity; rizatriptan acts as a 5-HT1B/1D agonist while atomoxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake with some serotonergic effects, creating potential for serotonin syndrome.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, muscle rigidity, hyperthermia); concurrent use is generally acceptable with appropriate clinical monitoring.
